facts.fact: Mauritania's national health insurance fund CNAM verifies insured persons by fingerprint or face, matched against the national ID card or by real-time query of the national agency ANRPTS through secure APIs, in all partner facilities since January 2025, per ISSA.
facts.system: CNAM biometric identification of insured persons

systems.system: CNAM biometric identification of insured persons

MRT.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Biometric matching at insurance use, not enrolment deduplication; the ID system itself is not described.
